modelingNotes: 35 Hudson Yards — procedural, CC0-1.0, no textures. bun generators/nyc-35-hudson-yards.ts

Map frame: x = model east (towards Tenth Avenue), y = model north (West 34th Street), z up, metres. Placed at bearing 29°, the Manhattan grid. Anchor: area centroid of the OSM outline way/468721008. Kit from nyc-30-hudson-yards.ts.

OSM way/468721008 and its parts 1089415971–81, which map the tower's tiers exactly: a 77 m base over the whole lot and a 26 m strip on its south and east sides; then a 35 × 34 m shaft whose corners round off one at a time at each setback (south-west at 135 m, south-east at 173 m, north-east at 210 m, north-west at 248 m); and a 276 m crown cut by a V notch in the middle of each face, the notches bottoming out at 282–290 m. Plans here are OSM's rings.
Published: 308 m (1,009 ft), 72 floors, David Childs / Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, 2019; residential over a hotel (Wikipedia). The crown is drawn to 308 m rather than OSM's 304.8 m.
No lidar: the 2017 USGS flight predates the tower.

Photos (Wikimedia Commons, daylight, several sides and from the north-east and west at a distance): /tmp/city/nyc/work/nyc-35-hudson-yards/photos/credits.txt. Glass between pale limestone piers, a pale horizontal band at every setback, the notched crown.
Estimated: the bay width (4.6 m, a little coarser than the real piers), four-storey panel rows, the colours, and the 26 m strip's facade.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "nyc-35-hudson-yards", model "nyc-35-hudson-yards"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/nyc-35-hudson-yards.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
